subject.title: perf(ci): O(1) boundary sticky key and 32 vCPU for the ext-package-boundary lane

question: Is a completed current-head cold-path timing plus the pinned action contract sufficient to land this PR before the first protected writer can demonstrate a warm `ext-boundary-v2` snapshot?
rationale: The shared warm path depends on an operator-side disk purge and a protected main event that pull-request runs cannot publish, so automation cannot independently obtain the decisive pre-merge warm-hit evidence.

options.title: Accept staged rollout
options.body: Require the current-head boundary job to complete successfully, confirm the stale-disk purge, then merge and monitor the first main publication and next warm PR hit.

options.title: Require seeded warm proof
options.body: Pause merge until an operator safely seeds or otherwise exercises the protected snapshot and provides a linked warm-hit timing transcript.

options.title: Pause for capacity recovery
options.body: Leave the PR open until Blacksmith mount capacity is restored and both cold and warm behavior can be measured directly.

recommendation.title: Accept staged rollout
recommendation.body: Require the current-head boundary job to complete successfully, confirm the stale-disk purge, then merge and monitor the first main publication and next warm PR hit.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the immediately preceding protected sticky-disk pattern and has the strongest recent history on the affected CI workflow.
